description: Every machine-based resource in the AWS inventory appears in declared state, or is excused by a stated and verified rule

exclusions.reason: Created by an AWS service when it is enabled, under the reserved /aws-service-role/ path, and required by services that persist (Config, GuardDuty, Inspector, Security Hub). Declaring them would put roles the provider owns into a teardown's reach.

The default VPC AWS creates in every region. Nothing in this project launches into it. Whether to delete it is a separate decision; while it exists, its absence from declared state is by design, not drift.
A default subnet of the default VPC, created by AWS with it.

The default VPC's own default security group, created by AWS and undeletable. Only the group named default in the default VPC qualifies; a group added there by anyone is not excused. The project VPC's default group is deliberately not excused -- see DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-23.
An AWS-managed key (aws/s3 and similar), created and rotated by the service that uses it. Not manageable by the account.
A customer key a teardown destroyed. KMS holds it in PendingDeletion for its waiting period before removing it; it left state when Terraform scheduled the deletion.

The operator identity that runs Terraform, created by hand before any root existed so it cannot be declared by what it creates. Excused from this check only: its static access key with AdministratorAccess and no MFA is an open finding (DECISIONS.md, 2026-09-23), not an accepted exclusion.
